_what: THE SWITCH (19 Nov 2026). Normally null = off. To use it: put an app version in stop_and_update_below, e.g. "v5.0.400", and deploy. Every app OLDER than that version then stops sending to the server (the work stays on the device) and shows a box with UPDATE NOW at its next safe moment. The box says 'This version is no longer supported. Please update Framehow to continue.' — or, if message is filled in, those words instead (plain text, 300 letters at most). Each app asks once a day, the first time it comes to the front with a connection. Only for an old version that does harm. Never flip it on the day of a release.
